args.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(f.SourceAirport) AS airport_code, TRIM(a.AirportName) AS airport_name FROM flights f JOIN airlines l ON f.Airline=l.uid LEFT JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.SourceAirport)=TRIM(a.AirportCode) WHERE l.Airline='United Airlines' ORDER BY airport_code
SELECT uid,Airline, (SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE f.Airline=a.uid) n,(SELECT quote(AirportCode) FROM airports LIMIT 1) sample FROM airlines a WHERE trim(Airline) LIKE '%United%'

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(f.SourceAirport) AS airport_code, TRIM(p.AirportName) AS airport_name FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON f.Airline=a.uid LEFT JOIN airports p ON TRIM(f.SourceAirport)=p.AirportCode WHERE TRIM(a.Airline)='United Airlines' ORDER BY airport_code
